Final For Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans —219 North Elizabeth Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: | DX-3 Downtown Mixed-Use District

Lot Area: 3,657.42 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to reuse and renovate the existing two-story
building and construct a partial third-floor addition to establish a restaurant
at the subject property. The building will measure 47 ft. in height, and its
footprint will remain without change. The subject property is a Transit
Served Location and will not provide off-street parking. Pursuant to Sec.
17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking all relief necessary, as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 7,911 square feet (2.16 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed

(C) The amount of off-street parking: zero

(D) — Setbacks:

a. Front Setback: 0 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 0 feet (existing)
East Side: 0 feet (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 0 feet (existing)

(E) Building Height: 47 feet (measured to the elevator overrun)
